summary: Facepalm: No facepalm candidates for 2026-11-25. Searches turned up only stories that broke the rules: events older than 7 days, non-US events, crimes with victims, injuries, Republican subjects (not allowed today), or no accepted second source. The search tool hit its usage limit before I could open a second source for any remaining lead. Genius: One genius candidate submitted: the BU-led CTE blood-marker study (JAMA, ~Nov 19), with WCVB, CBS Boston and BU pages. Other leads were set aside for lack of a second accepted source or a non-US origin. No facepalm story met the standard; nothing published. The verified genius story is on the bench for a later day.
